`class_name DialogueUI extends Control

const TICK_INTERVAL: float = 0.05
const CHARS_PER_SEC := 300.0

var _typewriter_tween: Tween = null

@onready var _dialogue_label: RichTextLabel = $CurrentDialogueLabel

func _ready() -> void:
	pass
	
func set_dialogue(new_dialogue: String) -> void:
	_dialogue_label.text = ""
	if _typewriter_tween and _typewriter_tween.is_valid():
		_typewriter_tween.kill()

	new_dialogue = new_dialogue.replace("\\n", "\n")
	visible = new_dialogue != "" and new_dialogue != null

	if visible:
		_dialogue_label.visible_ratio = 0
		_dialogue_label.text = new_dialogue

	_typewriter_tween = create_tween()
	var duration := float(new_dialogue.length()) / CHARS_PER_SEC
	_typewriter_tween.set_parallel(true)
	_typewriter_tween.tween_property(_dialogue_label, "visible_ratio", 1.0, duration)
	_setup_scrolling()

func _setup_scrolling() -> void:
	_dialogue_label.scroll_active = true
	
`
